messages:
Emmie - MKTG: Quick ask for the Serving Wins push: landing hero, benchmark slide (sparkline), compact inbound-routing PNG for ops, and three micro-explainers (cost/latency/quality). Need drafts by Tue noon.

Kai (Design): Copy for hero locked? And do we want illustrative or schematic treatment?

Emmie - MKTG: Headline for now: 'Serving Wins: predictable, economical inference.' Keep two supporting bullets: 'Latency SLOs across deployments' and 'Cost controls via batching & quantization'. Hybrid visual (schematic inset) preferred.

Nora - Creative Ops: Uploaded starter Figma kit: https://www.figma.com/file/aaaa/serve-wins-kit. Use comp set sw/micro-v1. Added localization tokens (EN/FR/DE) and export tokens.

Jules - Brand: Use stacked logo; no drop shadows; palette = /brand/palettes/visual.csv. Ensure text contrast >=4.5:1. Sparkline: SVG for slides + short MP4 for socials.

Evan PMM: Micro-explainers: dev (tokens/sec + latency win), enterprise (SLA/private deploy callout), finance (cost/unit + batching note). I'll post 1-line copy by 15:00.

Kai (Design): Draft export specs: hero 1400x800 (svg/png), microtiles 600x600 (svg/png), slide 1920x1080 (pptx/png), routing 1200x900 (svg). I'll add alt text layers.

Figma Bot: Component "sw/micro-v1" updated by Kai (Design) at 2026-03-26T01:02:10Z.

Nora - Creative Ops: I will run exports and accessibility checks when frames are ready. Naming convention: rdw_servewins_<asset>_<variant>_v1.*

Emmie - MKTG: Ping #marketing-ops when hero + slide are in Figma. We need the slide png for rehearsal Wed morning. Thanks! :rocket:
